[1/5] Fix the confirmed quality handoffs and precompute RoPE

impact_assessment.why: The report's defects were reproduced in this tree: control tokens split into 8 ids, generation ignores the end token, top-p leaks excluded tail mass to the weakest kept token, and the repetition penalty compounds per occurrence. RoPE also recomputes 12,288 trig pairs per token.
impact_assessment.benefits: Special tokens tokenise as one id; generation stops at end-of-turn; nucleus sampling preserves the requested distribution; penalty is per distinct token; 32 trig pairs per position instead of 12,288.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: SamplingParams gains penalty_window, Qwen2Config gains eos/eot ids, Tokenizer gains control-token matching; dependency: standard library only, no new packages; concurrency: RoPE table is read-only after load and sampling stays single-threaded; state: no persistence or file-format changes
impact_assessment.mitigation: Unit tests for each defect, greedy token ids compared before and after, tokenizer ids compared with the reference, and the full project gate run before commit

impact_assessment.mitigation: Unit and differential tests, the fidelity harness, 58/58 tests, 4/4 gates, and the measurement log updated
